description: Tier-0 ${for…lift} per-item if= REACTIVE unmount (SPEC §17.1) — THE half broken today (was a reactive display toggle: element hidden but STILL in the DOM). Both rows start on:true (visible). Clicking #hide1 maps @rows flipping id=1's on false; the per-item effect swaps Alice's <li> for a comment placeholder IN PLACE, so her row is STRUCTURALLY removed (count 2 -> 1), Bob keeps his identity (keyed).
rationale: §17.1 a per-item if= that flips true->false removes the element from the DOM. The pre-fix Tier-0 lowering set style.display='none' (element present), violating §17.1; the swap-in-place tracked node (element <-> comment, key transplanted) makes the flip a real unmount. Survivor id=2 pins keyed reconcile through the swap.
